title: Кібератака на державні організації України з використанням теми "Азовсталі" та шкідливої програми Cobalt Strike Beacon (CERT-UA#4490)

entities.name: UAC-0098
entities.gloss: A threat actor group tracked for conducting targeted cyberattacks against Ukrainian organizations.

entities.name: TrickBot
entities.gloss: A sophisticated cybercrime group known for developing and operating trojans, ransomware, and malicious loaders.

entities.name: Cobalt Strike Beacon
entities.gloss: A post-exploitation agent and penetration testing payload frequently abused by threat actors for remote access.

entities.name: Військові на Азовсталі.xls
entities.gloss: A malicious Excel spreadsheet containing macros used to drop and execute secondary malware payloads.

entities.name: pe.dll
entities.gloss: A malicious DLL protected with a crypter associated with TrickBot and used to deliver Cobalt Strike Beacon.

entities.name: notevil.dll
entities.gloss: A dynamic-link library containing a Cobalt Strike Beacon payload.

entities.name: shellcode.bin.packed.dll
entities.gloss: A packed DLL file containing shellcode associated with the cyberattack.

entities.name: spisok.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable file protected by a crypter linked to the TrickBot group.

entities.name: CERT-UA#4464
entities.gloss: A security alert issued by CERT-UA regarding malicious cyber activity.
An IP address used by threat actors to host and distribute malicious files.
An IP address identified as infrastructure used in malicious network operations.

entities.name: dezword.com
entities.gloss: A domain name utilized for malicious command and control communications.

entities.name: cherryservers.com
entities.gloss: A dedicated server and cloud hosting services provider.

entities.name: hostkey.com
entities.gloss: A web hosting and server infrastructure service provider.

relations.head: Військові на Азовсталі.xls
relations.evidence: останній здійснить завантаження, створення на диску та запуск файлу "pe.dll"

relations.head: pe.dll
relations.evidence: призведе до ураження комп'ютера шкідливою програмою Cobalt Strike Beacon

relations.head: UAC-0098
relations.evidence: ураження комп'ютера шкідливою програмою Cobalt Strike Beacon ... відстежуватиметься за ідентифікатором UAC-0098
